caption: The video captures a coastal scene beneath a low sun, with the bright disc sitting above the horizon left of center and a pale reflection spreading across the water. A dark rocky headland rises on the right, topped by a light-colored building, while a curved beach fills the foreground under an overcast grey sky. The framing remains essentially fixed, showing only slight handheld wobble as the sea continues moving gently. Small waves lap and retreat along the right shoreline. Their white foam edge widens, thins, and shifts shape over time. The glittering column of sunlight on the water breaks and reforms as ripples pass through it, while the sun, cliff, building, and horizon keep the same relative positions throughout the view. No people, vehicles, or moving objects enter the scene, and no deliberate pan, tilt, or zoom is visible in the handheld framing. The ongoing surf and shimmering reflection carry the motion, while the clouds, sea, and headland remain a stable backdrop in the coastal light.
